name: AI Disco — YouTube Tutorials — 15 day
description: Every 15 days: fetches 3 verified-channel tutorials per tool via YouTube Data API v3, writes youtube.json to GitHub. Frontend renders as thumbnail grid below cert rows on each tool card.

metadata.__NOTE__: Every 15 days. Day 4 of cycle (Cases=day1, YouTube=day4, Certs=day8, UseCases=day15).
Claude generates 80 optimal search queries. Short job — 60s timeout sufficient.
Parses the JSON string into an iterable array.
Iterator: loops over the parsed array. Each iteration is one tool (80 total). Ensure 'Iterate array' is configured on {{4}}.

YouTube Data API v3 search. REPLACE KEY. Get key at console.cloud.google.com > Create Project > Enable YouTube Data API v3 > Create Credentials > API Key. Quota: 100 units per search * 80 tools = 8000 units. Daily limit: 10000 units. Fits comfortably.
Fetches channel stats (subscriber count + verified status) for quality filter. 1 unit per channel lookup.
Shapes top 3 results per tool into a consistent JSON object. Note: items[1..3] — Make's indices are 1-based.
Aggregates all 80 tool-video objects into one array. Set 'Source module' = 5 (router).
Get SHA. First run: create youtube.json in repo with content [] first.

SETUP.1_youtube_api_key: Get a YouTube Data API key: console.cloud.google.com > Create Project 'ai-disco' > APIs & Services > Library > search 'YouTube Data API v3' > Enable > Credentials > Create API Key > copy the key. Free quota: 10,000 units/day.
SETUP.2_replace_all_keys: Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_YOUTUBE_API_KEY (2 places), REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN (2 places)
SETUP.3_first_run: Create youtube.json in your GitHub repo root with content [] (empty array) before first run. This gives the scenario a SHA to reference.
SETUP.4_module_5_configure: Module 5 (Router/Iterator): set source to module 4 output array. Each iteration passes one tool's {id, name, query} through.
SETUP.5_module_9_configure: Module 9 (Array Aggregator): Source = Module 5. Target structure = Custom.
SETUP.6_timeouts: Module 2 (Claude): 60s. Modules 6, 7 (YouTube API): 30s each. All others default.
SETUP.7_schedule: Every 15 days, day 4 of cycle. Spreads load across your automation pipeline (Cases day1, YouTube day4, Certs day8, UseCases day15).
SETUP.8_ops_cost: Per run: 1 Claude + (80 × 2 YouTube) + 2 GitHub + aggregators ≈ 165 ops. Monthly cost on 1000/month free tier: ~330 ops. Well under limit.

metadata.VERIFIED_CHANNEL_POST_PROCESSING: Verified-only filter is enforced client-side in JS (lookup table below). Adds a VERIFIED_CHANNELS constant listing legitimate channels for the 80 tools. The frontend hides videos from channels not in the allow-list.
